{{For|[[Lost Glitch]]|other uses of [[Soul (Disambiguation)|Soul]]}} {{ModifierInfobox |image1 = LostSoulsModIcon.png |affects = Wave Layout
Enemy Stats
Map Appearance |active_in = [[Pizza Party]] |rewards_increase = None |sandbox = Yes |music-1 = [[File:-Official- Tower Defense Simulator OST - Lost Souls|center|250px|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|The game just got harder.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Lost Souls''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that increases the amount of enemies spawned, changes statistics of all enemies and makes the map have less saturation. Triumphing the [[Pizza Party]] map with '''Lost Souls''' modifier active grants you the [[Badges|The Lost Souls!]] badge, which allows you to claim the {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} skin for the [[Warden]] through the [[Gift Box]] menu. '''Lost Souls''' appears exclusively in [[Pizza Party]]; it is only active if all players have [[Scout]]/[[Golden Scout]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Commander]], and [[Minigunner]]/[[Golden Minigunner]] in their loadouts. Due to a bug, it always appears in [[Pizza Party]], though its effects are not applied until the requirements are met. The fifth tower can be any tower. ==Effects== ===Wave Layout=== When active, '''Lost Souls''' increases the spawns of all enemies in each wave by 50%, always rounded down when spawning. ===Enemy Stats=== All enemies will spawn with an additional 20% defense. ===Map Appearance=== '''Lost Souls''' also changes the screen to have way less saturation, making it harder to see. A special music track will also start playing. ==Trivia== *The method of activating '''Lost Souls''' (having the specified towers in all players' inventories) references the [[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]], [[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]], [[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] and [[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]] enemies. *Rarely, the icon for this modifier will be displayed twice on the screen. This is merely a visual glitch. **In some cases, the icon for this modifier can appear in regular matches, despite '''Lost Souls''' not being active. *When restarting after losing with this modifier active, the map colors may become inverted instead of black and white. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **'''Lost Souls''' added. *'''31 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.5]] **{{Bug}} When activated, the music is replaced by the '''Lost Souls''' intro played on loop. *'''21 June 2024''' - [[v1.25.0]] **Player count requirement removed, now can be activated in solos. *'''18 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.7]] **{{Bug}} No longer plays the intro at all in [[Pizza Party]]. **{{Bug}} No longer decreases map saturation. **{{Bug}} No longer boosts [[Wox the Fox]] health. **{{Bug}} No longer gives {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} [[Warden]] skin or its badge. *'''15 January 2025''' - [[v1.49.0]] **{{Bug}} Saturation breaks when applied multiple times in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bugfix}} Now decreases map saturation. **{{Bugfix}} Intro now plays again in [[Pizza Party]]. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **{{Bug}} Now always appears in [[Pizza Party]]. **{{Bugfix}} Saturation no longer breaks when applied multiple times in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0|v1.50.1]] **{{Bugfix}} Now gives {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} [[Warden]] skin and its badge. }} {{ModifierNavBox}}
